skills.description: Fix Excel cell overflow/truncation issues by auto-detecting cells with content exceeding cell boundaries and applying wrap text + row height adjustments. Only modifies the "审定表" sheet (audit confirmation sheet), leaving all other sheets untouched. Use when processing financial audit working papers (.xlsx/.xls) where cell content is cut off or not fully visible when printing. Triggered by requests involving cell overflow, truncated text, row height adjustment, print formatting, or audit working paper formatting.
